    Docs/Connector.sln/Connector.Core/src-Connector.Core-DynamicExport
    Module

    src/Connector.Core/DynamicExport

    Layer domain · project Connector.Core

    Project navigation: Connector.Core

    Overview 🤖

    Contains records and classes for configuring and normalizing export mappings for data connectors.

    Responsibilities. Defines the structure and normalization logic for export mappings, including fields, relations, and nested groups.

    Usage. Used by various parts of the Connector application to configure and process data exports.

    AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself.

    Key components

    Component Kind Used by Summary
    ExportMappingJson class 9 Deserializes ExportMappingConfig stored as AppSetting JSON, repairing configs saved before relations gained a Fields list, Delimiter, and relation-level FlattenStrategy: System.Text.Json leaves a missing property at its type default — null for the string and array properties here — rather than the value the old shape implied, which crashes every consumer that dereferences it. Every read of the export_mapping/export_presets AppSetting values must go through this instead of a raw Deserialize<T>` call.
    ExportNodeJson class 9 Deserializes an ExportNode tree stored as JSON (on ExportDefinitionEntity.RootNode), backfilling missing properties the same way ExportMappingJson does for the legacy mapping shape: System.Text.Json leaves a missing property at its type default rather than the value an older saved tree implied, which would otherwise crash every consumer that dereferences it. Every read of a persisted ExportNode tree must go through this instead of a raw Deserialize<T>` call.
    ExportNode record 4 One node in a recursive export tree. Generalizes ExportMappingNestedGroup (which only covers "object"/"array" nesting for JSON output) to also represent the root and plain scalar columns, so a single tree — walked by one query builder and honored by every format writer (CSV/Excel/JSON) — replaces the old parallel Fields/Relations/NestedGroups shapes. Children lets root/object/array nodes nest arbitrarily deep; a scalar-field node has no children.
    ExportRecordSelection record 1 Optional, server-derived root selection: the configured correlation column and caller-supplied values. The SQL compiler binds the values as parameters and intersects them with the saved root filter.
    ExportJsonMetadataField record 0 One key/value pair in the JSON export's metadata block. When IsDynamicTimestamp is true, Value is ignored and the actual export timestamp is substituted at build time.
    ExportJsonWrapperConfig record 0 Configures the JSON export envelope: an optional root key, the items array key, and metadata field naming. Null on JsonWrapper preserves the legacy flat envelope.
    ExportMappingConfig record 0 The complete mapping config for one source table, including field remaps and relation flattening. NestedGroups and JsonWrapper are JSON-export-only and additive: CSV/Excel export and every pre-existing saved mapping ignore them entirely.
    ExportMappingField record 0 A single column mapping with source name, target export name, and enabled flag.

    ExportMappingNestedGroup

    record · ExportMappingTypes.cs

    A JSON-only nested structure: either a single embedded object (Kind="object", an N:1 lookup join) or an array of embedded objects (Kind="array", a 1:N join). Children lets groups nest arbitrarily deep (e.g. item → manufacturer → addresses), each recursing within its parent's JSON expression.
